- Position the vehicle on the lift.

The oil should be changed with the engine hot to facilitate the drainage of the used oil.

- Remove the filler cap

- Release the dipstick.

- Raise the vehicle.

See in Op. 7055B54 PROTECTION/GUARD under engine - R.R.

- Position a suitable container under the vehicle by the drain plug.

1. Undo the drain plug in the crankcase sump and leave the oil to drain into the container.

Be very careful when removing the drain plug; the oil could be very hot.

Do not let the oil disperse into the atmosphere as this could cause pollution.
